Maya (Japanese: マヤ Maya) is a recurring character in . She is a Sea Priestess of the Whirl Islands.

Maya is responsible for keeping the culture and tradition of the Whirl Cup alive. Like generations of great before her, she oversees the Whirl Cup competition with the magical power of the Great Sea Spirit Sapphire. It is said that she can communicate with when she evokes the Sea Spirit Union.

She watched over the Whirl Cup in Dueling Heroes and The Perfect Match!. Maya is very confident, as was proven when Officer Jenny warned her that the Sea Spirit was about to be stolen. Maya smiled and told the officer not to worry about what may happen.
